name: Graphiti
short_desc: Temporal knowledge graph API for AI agents
description: Self-host the Graphiti graph service with a persistent Neo4j database. Bring an OpenAI API key for graph extraction and embeddings. The reference API has no authentication; keep it private and do not expose it to untrusted networks.
author: Zep

form_fields.label: OpenAI API Key
form_fields.hint: Required by the default Graphiti model configuration.
